metrics.name: entity_precision
metrics.definition: TP / (TP + FP) over engineer-reviewed entity predictions

metrics.name: entity_recall
metrics.definition: TP / (TP + FN) over engineer-labelled gold entities

metrics.name: retrieval_hit_at_5
metrics.definition: Questions with at least one expected evidence page in top 5 / answerable questions

metrics.name: citation_validity
metrics.definition: Returned citations whose document and page exist / all returned citations

metrics.name: abstention_quality
metrics.definition: Unanswerable questions for which system avoids unsupported claims / all unanswerable questions

metrics.name: reviewed_change_precision
metrics.definition: Engineer-confirmed revision changes / all proposed changes

reporting_note: These are definitions and proposed evaluation criteria, not measured results.
